name: RADIOTHERAPY_DICOM_INFO
description: This table contains identifiers to DICOM files used in the radiotherapy plan.

columns.name: RT_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the radiotherapy summary record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: SOP_CLASS_SYSTEM
columns.description: Stores the system for the associated SOP class.

columns.name: SOP_CLASS_SYSTEM_VERSION
columns.description: Stores the version of the associated system.

columns.name: SOP_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the SOP class code for the associated DICOM instance UID.

columns.name: SOP_CLASS_USER_SELECTED_YN
columns.description: Stores whether the user manually selected the SOP class code was chosen directly by the user.

columns.name: SOP_CLASS_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Stores the display name for the associated SOP class code.
